references.text: The recipe for the holy anointing oil that Moses used to anoint the tabernacle and everything in it.
God commands Moses to take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it to consecrate it.
Refers to the day when Moses completed setting up the tabernacle, anointed it, and consecrated it along with all its equipment.
Instructions to anoint the altar to consecrate it, which is part of what Moses carried out in Leviticus 8:10.
Continuation of the anointing ritual where Moses sprinkles oil on the altar and anoints Aaron.
Compares brotherhood with the precious oil that ran down over Aaron's head, a poetic reference to the anointing.
In the New Testament, it is mentioned that Moses sprinkled blood on the tabernacle and all the vessels used in the service as part of the consecration process.
